cases.title: Two focus layers: A and Shift+P asked first; one pivot moved on the layer they care less about; frames at the same time; Edit > Undo

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor asks the learner to select Tab and press A then Shift+P; in Turn 4 it takes a frame, runs anchor_demo on the one target (anchor/6, Tab), and takes a second frame at time 0; it then says Anchor Point and Position both changed and that 'Tab itself didn't move', gives Edit > Undo, and reads out no values (calling the frames too small to compare is allowed under the blank-frame rule).

In Turn 4 the mentor says Anchor Point and Position changed 'by the same amount in opposite directions', but the anchor_demo result shows both x values going down by the same amount (anchor 100→0, position 620→520), so this claims a result the tool didn't return.

Every name and time the mentor uses (Door, Tab, Title, Wobble, Seal, Mentor Practice 2, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s) appears in the tool results or the learner record, and 'two weeks ago' matches the record's 2026-10-12 lesson date.
